text: Program Description The Training Objectives This program is based on core skills of Accreditation Board for Artificial Intelligence that meets the requirements of Shanghai University of Engineering Science instructional guidelines. The curriculum provides a broad education in the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence. The SUES core is made up of a general education courses and spescific Artificial Intelligence requirements of the accreditation guidelines such as Machine Learning, Group Intelligence, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing, Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality. The educational objectives are to provide each graduate with: 1) Engineering Competence that graduates are competent and engaged professionals in their field; 2) Continuous Learning Skills that graduates continue developing professionally; 3) Professional Skills that graduates demonstrate teamwork and leadership skills, and are contributors in their profession; 4) Societal Awareness that graduates recognize the societal, ethical, and global impacts of their work. Main Courses Machine Learning, Group Intelligence, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing, Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality, etc.
